month_theme: English exam week — then pivot to Econ and Spanish

notes: English owns Monday through Friday. Do not open Econ or Spanish before Thursday — you need full concentration on English this week. After Paper 2 on Friday, the pivot to Econ and Spanish starts immediately on Saturday. Both are May 12-13, which means you only have the weekend to prepare. Keep the Econ and Spanish review tight and high-signal: diagrams, essay structure, and key theme vocabulary — no broad rereading. Math and Chemistry get their dedicated window from May 9 onward.
